nodes.label: Cactus Top Texture
nodes.description: Minecraft-style cactus block top face texture. Depicts the cross-section of a cactus from above with a star or radial pattern of dark green ridges on a medium green field, and small spine dots around the outer edge. Color palette: medium green, dark green ridges, tiny white/light spine specks. Used as the top face of cactus blocks.
